items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: It's called Maxson. His name is Maxson. Well, he's a president of the lady two-lane.

ctx.x: Yeah, they got men. The president's a man. Yeah, he's a man. But most of them women clubs, they got women presidents. Yeah, most of them. It's called Maxson. His name is Maxson. Well, he's a president of the lady two-lane. But all the rest of those women's society have women.
Do you sing at meetings, by the way?
